grf.observed_reality: Merged TypeRef canonicalization on product main was stack-total but copied branch-local alias ancestry. Concurrent candidate work converged on a mutable DFS active-path mechanism.
grf.hypothesis: A single mutable active-alias DFS path with explicit leave frames removes repeated ancestry-set copying while preserving fail-closed direct/structural cycle detection and sibling provenance.
grf.counter_reality: Mutable path state can leak or unwind too early across structural siblings, producing missed or false cycles; exact-head/provenance mistakes can also make a green PR-merge-context run look like head evidence.
grf.collapse: RETAIN/PROMOTE the bounded alias-ancestry repair only. Generic type semantics, full effect semantics, and whole Clay Machine completion remain OPEN.

unusual_experiment.name: BROOM_ALIAS_DEPTH_WIDTH
unusual_experiment.topology: Alias chain depth N terminating in one parameterized Hub with width N leaf parameters; N in [128,256,512,1024,2048].
unusual_experiment.purpose: Stress simultaneous ancestry depth and sibling width, where the old copy-per-child mechanism duplicates the inherited alias set at every child.
unusual_experiment.rollback: Ephemeral isolated harness only; no product mutation was made by the experiment.

pr_605.reason: pull_request GITHUB_SHA resolves to the PR merge branch commit unless the workflow explicitly uses github.event.pull_request.head.sha.

provenance_discovery.primary_source: GitHub Actions documentation: pull_request GITHUB_SHA is the last merge commit of the PR merge branch; use github.event.pull_request.head.sha for the head commit.
